_about: Tracker variants for the ID-persistence experiment (notes/tracking.md).
Every variant runs on the SAME saved detections, so differences come from tracking alone.
'extends' copies the parent variant and overrides only the keys given; 'params' are merged
key by key when the tracker type is the same, and replaced when the tracker type changes.
min_conf: detections below this never reach the tracker.
lost_buffer_s: how long a vehicle that is no longer detected keeps its ID.
params: constructor arguments of the tracker class in the 'trackers' package (v2.7).

baseline.label: Baseline (original run)
baseline.note: Reproduces the first 30 s run: YOLO cut at 0.25, ByteTrack with a 1 s memory.

s1_lowconf.label: Step 1: feed faint boxes
s1_lowconf.note: Boxes from 0.10 to 0.50 may extend an existing track (ByteTrack's second matching stage) but cannot start one.

s2_bt_buf4s.label: ByteTrack, 4 s memory
s2_bt_buf4s.note: Lost-track memory 1 s -> 4 s (covers 75% of measured gaps).

s2_bt_buf6s.label: ByteTrack, 6 s memory
s2_bt_buf6s.note: Lost-track memory 1 s -> 6 s (longer than every measured gap).

s2_bt_buf4s_iou03.label: ByteTrack, 4 s memory, looser overlap
s2_bt_buf4s_iou03.note: Also accept matches with box overlap (IoU) down to 0.03 instead of 0.10.

s2_bt_buf4s_act04.label: ByteTrack, 4 s memory, high tier 0.4
s2_bt_buf4s_act04.note: Boxes from 0.40 (not 0.50) count as confident: they can start tracks and match in the first stage.

s2_ocsort_buf4s.label: OC-SORT, 4 s memory
s2_ocsort_buf4s.note: Observation-centric SORT: re-anchors the motion model on the last real observation after an occlusion.

s2_botsort_buf4s.label: BoT-SORT, 4 s memory
s2_botsort_buf4s.note: BoT-SORT without camera-motion correction (needs video frames; drift is handled in Phase 3) and without re-identification.

r2_botsort_first01.label: BoT-SORT, looser first match
r2_botsort_first01.note: Round 2 (designed after the round-1 audit). Confident boxes match at fused similarity 0.10 (was 0.20); faint boxes still need IoU 0.5.

r2_botsort_first005.label: BoT-SORT, loosest first match
r2_botsort_first005.note: Round 2. Confident boxes match at fused similarity 0.05; faint boxes still need IoU 0.5.

r2_botsort_first01_unc02.label: BoT-SORT, looser first + new-track match
r2_botsort_first01_unc02.note: Round 2. As first01, and unconfirmed (new) tracks match at 0.20 (was 0.30).

r2_ocsort_iou03.label: OC-SORT, default overlap 0.3
r2_ocsort_iou03.note: Round 2. OC-SORT at its default IoU 0.3 (was 0.1) to curb the wrong merges seen in round 1.

r2_ocsort_iou03_buf2s.label: OC-SORT, overlap 0.3, 2 s memory
r2_ocsort_iou03_buf2s.note: Round 2. As r2_ocsort_iou03 with a 2 s memory: its round-1 wrong merges came after long gaps (median 33 frames).

r2_bt_conf015_buf4s.label: ByteTrack, faint floor 0.15, 4 s memory
r2_bt_conf015_buf4s.note: Round 2. Middle ground between baseline (0.25) and step 1 (0.10): fewer faint junk boxes reach the tracker.
